issues.title: Horizontal clipping in side drawer
issues.description: The drawer opens as a cramped side sheet on a 360px viewport, clipping Arabic text lines mid-word.
issues.evidence: The dark pane on the right edge cuts off text such as 'ننقل نافذة ا' without enough horizontal reading space.
issues.suggestion: Use a full-width bottom sheet pattern on mobile viewports instead of a persistent side panel.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: at 360px a 240px side sheet left an ~88px scrimmed column clipping the transcript mid-word; Drawer.Content now stretches to full frame width below 30rem (mobile:w-full) so the sheet becomes the reading surface on phones.

issues.title: Desktop dismissal copy on mobile
issues.description: Footer hint mentions the Esc key and suggests an incorrect drag direction for a right-anchored drawer.
issues.evidence: Base of drawer reads 'Drag the sheet left or press Esc to dismiss'.
issues.suggestion: Update copy to touch-relevant dismiss gestures with the correct swipe direction.
issues.triageNote: The captured string lives in the eval page (page-owned), but the same wrong-direction desktop copy shipped in the component demo; demo hint now reads 'Drag the sheet right' and drops the Esc mention below 30rem (touch-only copy).

issues.title: Incorrect gesture hint direction
issues.description: Footer text directs users to drag left to dismiss a right-anchored drawer.
issues.evidence: Footer text displays 'Drag the sheet left or press Escape to dismiss.'
issues.suggestion: Update copy to 'Drag the sheet right or press Escape to dismiss.'
issues.triageNote: Wrong-direction drag copy confirmed in the shipped demo ('drag left' for a right-anchored sheet); demo corrected to 'Drag the sheet right'. The identical string on the eval page is page-owned and cannot be edited here.
